description: NXP PCA9685 — 16-channel 12-bit PWM driver, I2C controlled, 5.5V tolerant outputs. TSSOP-28 package. Built-in 25MHz oscillator. The standard servo/LED PWM driver.
name: pca9685
watch_out_for: 16ch 12-bit PWM over I2C (addr via A0-A5 straps). OE active-low: pull low or drive; outputs are 25mA class, drive servos via their own 5V rail.
